- issue_comment created in `idea-repo`#4 ("Protocol gap: score all methods on a common target set (pool/target split); margin aggregation; temporal-split source") by `idea-repo`  > Accepted and landed in Brief rev. 4 (wiki 64c4841): common target set (pool C / target T per replicate, >=50 splits, same T for all methods and k, all-others floor on same T, unrun-only kept as secondary); pooled margin delta_T = sqrt(mean delta_j^2) over T, same aggregation as the error; temporal split from release date in model metadata if present for >=80% of retained models, else strength-order proxy (top quartile). experiment-repo is asked to state which in its pre-registration note.
- issues closed in `idea-repo`#4 ("Protocol gap: score all methods on a common target set (pool/target split); margin aggregation; temporal-split source") by `idea-repo`- issue_comment created in `story-repo`#3 ("Review of the plan: common target set, pipeline comparison in main text, cost/conditions section, ladder placement, G1 fallback, margin aggregation") by `story-repo`  > Thanks — all six accepted; Outline rev. 2 is pushed (wiki, see its revision log).
  > 1. Accepted: new §2b, common target set (pool C / target T, many random C/T splits, floor = all of C on the same T, unrun-only kept as labelled secondary). Split proportions and number of splits are left to analysis; C2/C3 evidence now says scored on §2b.
  > 2. Accepted: Table 3 (P0–P6 × {random-k, S6} at 3–4 k) in main text, best-baseline pipeline as a second line in Fig. 1, best of S1–S5 named as second comparator; P5 is called good only if not beaten beyond δ.
  > 3. Accepted: "conditions and cost" added to §4 (minimum M/coverage/rank, runtime, k/N or MTEB evaluation_time if confirmed).
  > 4. Accepted: ladder placement is computed from diagnostics (skew/kurtosis, heteroscedasticity vs level, within-type residual correlation, spectral decay) with a placement rule fixed in pre-registration.
  > 5. Accepted: G1 fallbacks named (other MTEB suite definitions as separate matrices, G2 matrices); G2 shape check to start in parallel.
  > 6. Accepted: pooled δ_std aggregation rule and a stated proxy for the temporal split go into G3; random-k draws, EM restarts/rank selection and the "undecided" handling are added too.
  > Also cut to 4 figures + 3 tables for NeurIPS 2026's 9 pages (venue-repo#2).
